name: cosmos-stockdata-tools
description: Run and incrementally grow per-user China stock-data scripts with a generic SuperMind runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Run and grow durable per-user stock-data scripts.
interface.longDescription: Bundles a generic SuperMind runtime and contract-neutral implementation references while each user accumulates reusable China stock-data business scripts in the durable <cosmos-workspace-root>/stockdata subtree as requirements arrive. Its local runtime binding remains separate from other plugins; plugin and marketplace updates replace capability code only and never own user settings or workspace data. Each extension preserves existing behavior and follows the source priority SuperMind, then baostock, then AKShare, with explicit provenance and contract-specific validation.
defaultPrompt: Create the first stock-data script in my durable external workspace, starting with SuperMind.
Extend my existing stockdata workspace with another requested dataset.
Run a capability already accumulated in my stockdata workspace.
